notes.title: 🔥 FIREPLACE SIMULATOR - MAJOR UPDATE: THE CHOPPING BLOCK 🪓
notes.content:
[p]I am excited to bring you another major update, wood chopping and log management, along with a suite of improvements to make your virtual hearth experience even more immersive.
[/p][h2]🪓 NEW FEATURE: WOOD CHOPPING MINIGAME[/h2][p]Step outside and feel the satisfaction of preparing your own firewood:[/p][list][*][p][b]Satisfying Chopping Mechanics[/b] - Test your timing with the chopping system[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill-Based Rewards[/b] - Better chops yield more firewood[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seamless Integration[/b] - Bring your chopped wood directly back to feed your fire[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Feedback[/b] - Watch as your perfect swings split logs into perfectly sized pieces
[/p][/*][/list][h2]🌬️ ENHANCED SMOKE PHYSICS[/h2][list][*][p][b]Flue Control System[/b] - Properly manage your chimney flue[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Smoke Behavior[/b] - Watch smoke respond realistically to objects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wind Interaction[/b] - Experience how drafts and open windows affect your fire and smoke
[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐕 COMPANION IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*][p][b]Refined Dog Behavior[/b] - Your faithful companion now interacts more naturally with the environment[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Dog UI[/b] - Dog thought tool tips
[/p][/*][/list][h2]🏆 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS

[/h2][h2]🛠️ ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][list][*][p][b]UI Refinements[/b] - Cleaner interfaces throughout[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimizations[/b] - Smoother experience on all systems[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b] - Fixed numerous small issues
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support and feedback. This update was built with your suggestions in mind, and I can't wait to hear what you think![/p]

notes.title: Regular Update (April): Everyone's Best Friend!
notes.content:
I'm excited to release a new update that adds a faithful dog companion to your fireside experience!

Key features:
Dog companion in Standard and Survival modes.
Feed and interact - Your dog gets hungry and his bowl will need to be filled from time to time.  
Growth and Loyalty - Your dog will transition between states of growth and trust/loyalty. 

Enjoy your new furry friend!

notes.title: Fireplace Simulator - Major Update!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce another major update for Fireplace Simulator is now LIVE! I've been working hard to bring you a more immersive and feature-rich experience as you enjoy the crackling comfort of your virtual hearth.

✨ [u][b]New Features[/b][/u]

🥶 Survival Mode
New challenging gameplay mode where temperature matters
Keep your fire burning to maintain warmth
Unlock rewards as you survive longer

🔥 Enhanced Fire Mechanics
Match System - Strike matches to light your fires! Hold right click to start strike.

📻 Radio
Tune into the radio while you relax by the fire
Right-click to change songs and discover new music

📚 Interactive Books
A fully-functional book system with turning pages
Curl up by the fire with classic literature
Right click to change stories

⏰ Functional Clock
Real-time clock that shows the current time
Toggle between real-world time and in-game time

🌲 Wood Type Variety
Discover and unlock different types of wood as you play
Each wood type features unique burning characteristics and visuals
Experiment to find your perfect fire aesthetic

🏆 New Achievements
A variety of new achievements to unlock
Show off your mastery of all things fireside
Some might require a bit of experimentation to discover...

🔧 Optimizations & Improvements
Overall performance enhancements
Various quality-of-life improvements

🔮 What's Next?
I have more features planned for future updates. Your feedback continues to be invaluable in shaping the future of Fireplace Simulator.

So stoke those flames, put your feet up, and enjoy. I hope it brings you some warmth and relaxation.

notes.content:

notes.title: Fireplace Simulator’s Biggest Update Yet – Rebuilt from the Ground Up!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a massive update to Fireplace Simulator, now completely rebuilt in Unity. Originally a simple 2D experience, we’ve overhauled everything to create a more immersive and realistic fireplace simulation. With upgraded graphics and new interactive features, this latest version will bring you closer to the warm glow of the fire than ever before.

What’s New:

3D Environments – Enjoy realistic lighting, textures, and dynamic shadows.

Steam Achievements - More coming!

Enhanced Interactivity – Explore the environment for additional interactive elements.

Customization - Multiple ways to customize your fireplace experience.

Whether you’re looking for a relaxing break or a cozy backdrop for your next gathering, we hope you’ll love this upgraded version as much as we do. We can’t wait to hear your feedback.
